text:
Nina Lopez: hey all, onboarding quick question — our new SDR, Theo, is live today but we can't get his HubSpot calls to show up on the East SDR dashboard. also want to load two voicemail drops (intro + follow-up). who do I ping?
Riley (salesops): pinged! I can take the voicemail templates and HubSpot seat mapping. for voicemail, do you want script variants or plain text?
Nina Lopez: script variants pls. short intro (~12s) and a slightly longer follow-up (~25s).
Riley (salesops): got it. drafts: 
- Intro (short): "Hey, this is Theo from Redwood Inference. We help teams lower LLM inference latency and cost. Call 415-0225 if interested."
- Follow-up (longer): "Hi, Theo from Redwood Inference again. Wanted to share how teams cut token cost with smart caching and batching. Reply or call 415-0225 to chat."
Riley (salesops): steps to add in Aircall: Settings → Voicemail → Templates → New. then assign to cassette SDR-East. I can add Theo if you drop his email.
Nina Lopez: theo@redwood.dev. thanks. HubSpot mapping error was "seat_provisioner: team_not_assigned" when I ran the self-serve.
Riley (salesops): that error usually means the org tag in the HR roster is missing or their Google account isn't linked. @access-bot can you lookup theo@redwood.dev?
access-bot: Lookup for theo@redwood.dev: Google Workspace user present: false. HR tag: missing. Actions: 1) IT invite to Google Workspace (ticket created #IT-9910); 2) HR to add org tag "sdr-east" in payroll roster. Provisioning will succeed after both complete.
Marcus (AE): if this needs to be demo-ready today, recommend temporary workaround: add Theo to the Aircall cassette and use a shared HubSpot seat (SDR_East_Shared) for calls until provisioning completes. Not ideal for attribution but works short-term.
Nina Lopez: ok can we do the shared seat for now. how do I request it?
Riley (salesops): I'll add Theo to Aircall now. for shared HubSpot seat I've got a workflow: update the SalesOps mapping sheet row for SDR_East_Shared and trigger provisioning. marking as TEMP in the note.
Riley (salesops): checklist (adding here so thread is single source of truth):
- create two voicemail templates (intro, follow-up)
- add Theo to Aircall SDR-East cassette
- open IT ticket #IT-9910 (invite to Google Workspace)
- request HR add org tag 'sdr-east'
- provision temporary shared HubSpot seat SDR_East_Shared
Riley (salesops): ETA for voicemail + Aircall add: 10–15m. provisioning depends on IT/HR.
IT-admin: IT ticket #IT-9910 created and owner assigned. ETA 30m for workspace invite.
access-bot: IT ticket updated: invited theo@redwood.dev to Google Workspace. Status: invited.
Nina Lopez: thanks everyone. Marcus — noted about attribution, we'll flag on the SDR handoff doc so pipeline ops knows to reassign once permanent seat is live.
Marcus (AE): perfect. one tiny ask — when adding voicemail drops can you set caller ID to the regional pool? last month some drops showed the west number and replies were confusing.
Riley (salesops): yep will set caller ID to SDR-East pool. I'll post back here when everything's live. :thumbsup:
Nina Lopez: closing once Theo confirms he can leave drops and calls show on dashboard. appreciate the fast help! :raised_hands:
